rumours_heard: Day 5, the Buried Temple (L1 2): three Red Eye gnolls, Friendly, taking the party for new recruits: 'the Lady Below' rewards any band that wipes out one of her lesser tribes, as she rewarded the Red Eye gnolls.
Day 27, Türos Tem: Priestess Genelen (Friendly, to Faustina) confided that villagers and soldiers suffer nightmares; she suspects a curse.
Day 27, Türos Tem: Priestess Genelen said there is a place in the Viaspen Forest so evil the gods sealed it beneath a mountain of rock.
Day 28, Türos Tem: the legate (Indifferent) said elves still live in the forests of Southern Argollë, gone feral and craving the flesh of men.

Day 33, the buried temple (L1): friendly orcs, taking the party for new recruits: 'the great purple one' sleeps in the stepped tower in the inner courtyard and takes a hundred gold a head to let anyone go down to the Lady; they invited the party to help wipe out a lesser tribe for her reward (declined).
Day 35, the road below Türos Tem (21.20): friendly pilgrims bound for the Shrine of the White Lady, a day or two north-east up the Krysivor, where a white unicorn drinks from the holy pool.

Day 50, Türos Aster: Legate Nicus Balens (Indifferent) repeated his standing offer: whoever clears the bugbear tribe out of the Ruined Imperial Fortress across the ford (26.19) is raised to patrician (baron) with a claim to the stronghold.
Day 52, Türos Tem: the legate (Friendly, to Faustina): Southern Argollë has grown far more dangerous since the Tarkaun stripped the garrisons for his wars in the west.
Day 52, Türos Tem: the legate (Friendly, to Faustina): the Black Fang and Red Eye gnolls are the toughest of the beastman warbands hereabouts.

Day 87, the Catacombs (L2 9): Ur-Shet of the Black Fangs (Friendly): the Lady never leaves her inner fane; black-robed priests at the fane east of the stair test visitors; the Red Eyes tend her breeding pool by their cavern; the dead guard her doors; the stinking ones stalk the tunnels and hate her; the red water changes those who drink it.
Day 88, the Buried Temple (L1 20): drinking brigands (Friendly): Drusus lost a patrol down the spiral stair weeks ago, when the dead came up it.
Day 108, the Buried Temple (L1 27): Apsa's orcs: five Red Eyes wait at the foot of the wyrm's stair; Hepsis wants the wyrm-slayers brought to him.

Day 122, the Catacombs (L2 22): Ur-Namu, captive (intimidated): the Lady keeps the Stone on a bone altar in the Inner Fane with captives; twelve skeletons and eight zombies guard its south side, six zombies the bend south of the Outer Fane; the dead let pass only those who show her sign; the short way in is two doors sealed by her magic, a horror between them.
Day 132, the Catacombs (L2 38): Ur-Shet (Friendly): the stinking ones come up from cracks in the deep south caves, beyond the ghoul hole and the slime caves; nobody follows them down.

Day 134, Türos Tem: Priestess Genelen (Friendly, to Faustina): the Stone is a shard of the Tablet of Destiny, broken long ago; it calls the Chaotic to it and festers where it lies; broken, it leaves pieces that are holy to Mityara's order and must come to it; its corruption seeks the hand that breaks it, so it should be broken with care and the place consecrated after.

Day 134, Türos Tem: Annalist Socolo read the Lady's unsent letter (Ancient Zaharan): to a "Lord of Secrets"; she tells of finding the Stone and feeding it, and offers herself and its power to the Lord's "dark mission".
